name: comp-157

frames.best_why: Five-star row is selected with its dot filled and the All reviews row cleared, showing the group in use.

tagline: Rows of stars with review counts pick a rating to filter by.
summary: A vertical radio list of review ratings, from all reviews down to one star, each row showing amber stars, dimmed empty stars and a count. Choosing a row keeps that rating selected.
appearance: Six rows on a near-black panel: a round radio outline on the left, a small gap, then white text. The top row reads All reviews with a grey count; the other five hold five small amber stars, the unused ones faded, then a grey count.
behaviour: Hovering a row draws a soft ring around its radio circle. Clicking a row moves the white dot there: the demo opens with All reviews chosen and ends on five stars.
demo_content: All reviews (12,921), 5 stars (5,168), 4 stars (4,726), 3 stars (3,234), 2 stars (1,842), 1 star (452)
search_phrases: choose a star level from a list
radio list with stars and totals
pick the number of stars for reviews
use_when: Narrowing a review or listing to one star level, with the count for each level beside it.
avoid_when: Copy, counts and the six rows are fixed inside the file, so a new rating level needs a source edit.
customise: Labels, counts and stars are written in the file; change them by editing it. Add or remove rows by copying a row block. Accent colour is one amber utility class.
weight_why: Six static rows of icon SVGs and native radio inputs; nothing runs after mount.

a11y.note: Native radio inputs give arrow-key navigation, and star rows carry hidden text labels. Counts are part of the label, so long totals are read out too.

issues: Review counts are small grey text on black and hard to read.
polish_why: Even row rhythm and a clear selected state; the counts sit low in contrast.
title: Star Rating Filter Radio
